The '''Battle of Giju''' was a brief conflict fought on [[Giju/Legends|Giju]] shortly after the establishment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==The battle==
The Empire desired to nationalize the industry and infrastructure on Giju and subjugated the planet. This spurred a short, but violent revolt by the native [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]], which was only ended after horrific massacres forced the Herglic to reconsider their resistance. They submitted completely to the Empire.<ref name="DFRS" />

==Aftermath==
Because Giju surrendered so rapidly, much of the infrastructure remained intact throughout the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] and the Herglic become loyal Imperial workers. This lead to a rapid economic recovery for the Herglic after Imperial forces fled the sector.<ref name="DFRS" />
